changes: OptAB-combination fix for the CRITICAL story-metadata data-loss bug. (A) worktree.ts bootstrap now force-adds (git add -f) so INIT_CHECK never hard-fails with paths-are-ignored, plus a post-commit git check-ignore guard on the actual metadata leaf that emits a loud DATA-LOSS warning when the project default would still leave it untracked. (B) new lattice doctor "story metadata protection" scan (text + --json) that flags the neither-tracked-nor-protected state, and doctor --repair that neutralizes a conflicting bare .lattice/ directory ignore then installs the managed ignore-volatile/track-metadata allowlist (reusing the existing runtime-artifact-registry allowlist via the exported managed-assets mergeRuntimeGitignore). New pure predicate core/story-metadata-protection.ts (unsafe = ignored && !tracked) shared by bootstrap, doctor, and a 10-check smoke.
usage: Bootstrap is automatic (git add -f). For an existing or downstream project that may be unsafe, run: lattice doctor (shows ✗ story metadata is neither git-tracked nor protected ... when unsafe) then lattice doctor --repair to install the allowlist; re-run lattice doctor to confirm ✓. lattice doctor --format=json exposes storyMetadataProtection.unsafe/needsRepair.
expectedOutcome: On a project that ignores .lattice, bootstrap no longer prints "The following paths are ignored ... .lattice"; metadata is force-added/tracked. lattice doctor flags untracked-and-unignored metadata with a repair pointer; --repair makes it safe; a fresh project protected by default.
actualTranscript: Real-machine (worktree dist/cli.js): OLD git add exit 1 vs NEW git add -f exit 0 (leaf staged); doctor text "✗ story metadata is neither git-tracked nor protected by the managed ignore allowlist" + --json unsafe:true; doctor --repair installs the managed block + neutralizes bare .lattice/ → re-scan unsafe:false, git check-ignore leaf exit 1 (safe). 10-check smoke green. Full transcript at .lattice/story/actives/B-854c/evidence/transcript-diff.md.
outcomeDiff: No diff — actual matches expected on all four scenarios (bootstrap force-add, bootstrap warning text, doctor unsafe detection, doctor --repair + safe re-scan).
limitations: Doctor --repair must be run by the operator (or via init scaffolding) on already-misconfigured projects; the bootstrap force-add commits THIS story metadata but the doctor allowlist is what protects sibling/future paths from git clean. Approach C (relocating volatile vs persistent under different prefixes) was intentionally deferred as an out-of-scope layout migration.
pitfalls: The check-ignore guard MUST probe the actual metadata leaf (index.json), NOT the .lattice prefix — under a negation allowlist git check-ignore on the parent reports ignored even though the leaf is re-included (would false-positive a safe repo). A bare .lattice/ directory-form ignore makes the !.lattice/story/actives/** negation INERT (git parent-directory rule), so --repair must comment out that exact line before merging the allowlist. The global lattice binary may be a stale symlink — verify fixes against the worktree built dist/cli.js.
